text:
mira (design): Short thread : quick dark-mode tweak request before next console push — charts at 1px and inline code selection are still fragile on older monitors.

sam (frontend): Seen. What's the smallest set of token changes to make visible improvements?

mira (design): Three small changes: (1) inline code bg -> #07181c and border -> #12363c, (2) hairline boost: render 1px as 1.5px when devicePixelRatio===1, (3) hatch pattern for alert fills when cell <=8px. Also standardize label copy to "P95 latency".

lucy (product): +1 on P95 copy. Customers keep asking for units on embedding metrics too (tokens vs vectors) .

sam (frontend): I'll wire vars and add a runtime hatch toggle (prefers-contrast or user setting). Small CSS snippet I can use: `:root[data-theme="dark"]{--code-bg:#07181c;--code-border:#12363c;--text-main:#d8eef6;--series-alert:#ff9a5c}`

aria-bot: Accessibility check queued : will validate contrast and color-diff. Report ETA ~4m. :robot_face:

aria-bot: Report: flagged -> inline code border needs +1px strength on some displays; alert hatch recommended for deuteranopia at small cell sizes.

mira (design): Action: bump code-border to #16464e, enable hatch by default at <=8px, and add a short doc note about the hairline boost fallback.

sam (frontend): I'll implement the border bump and hatch default. Will add a hairline boost fallback for DPR=1 and include `prefers-reduced-motion` guard for any glow.

lucy (product): Nice. Please add a one-line release note: "Dark theme: improved hairlines, clearer inline code, P95 label polish, and accessibility hatches for dense charts."

mira (design): Will update the Figma tokens and attach assets to the PR. Ping me if aria-bot flags anything else.
